item.title: Senegal to know fate of AFCON title appeal Tuesday – CAS
item.description: The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) announced that a verdict on Senegal’s appeal of the decision to strip them of the Africa Cup of Nations title in favour of Morocco will come on Tuesday. CAS’s ruling comes after a hearing of the case, over a chaotic AFCON final in January, which took place behind closed doors at its headquarters in Lausanne on October 8. “The parties have been notified that the CAS decision will be rendered Tuesday 24 November 2026 in the course of the afternoon (GMT),” CAS said in a short statement on Monday. At the January 18 final in Rabat, Senegal won 1-0 thanks to Pape Gueye’s extra-time goal, but the occasion was marred near the end of normal time when many Senegal players walked off the pitch in protest at the decision to award Morocco a penalty with the match still goalless. Some Senegalese supporters also attempted a pitch invasion, and the game was held up for almost 20 minutes before the Senegal players returned. In March, the Confederation of African Football (CAF) overturned that result, awarding Morocco a 3-0 victory, and the title. In response, the Senegalese Football Federation (FSF) denounced the ruling as the “most blatant administrative robbery in the history of our sport”. The Senegal team even paraded the trophy to their supporters in Paris at the end of March. The post Senegal to know fate of AFCON title appeal Tuesday – CAS appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Mauricio Pochettino defends controversial Matthijs de Ligt call after Man Utd’s 4-0 Anfield humiliation by Liverpool
item.description: FBL-ENG-PR-LIVERPOOL-MAN UTD - AFP Mauricio Pochettino has defended his eyebrow-raising decision to throw Matthijs de Ligt straight into Manchester United’s starting XI for his debut in charge during a 4-0 thrashing by Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday. The new Red Devils boss explained why he handed the Dutchman his first Premier League start in nearly a year. Pochettino stands by De Ligt selection The Dutch international had not featured in the league for 357 days due to a long-term back injury, yet found himself thrown into the heat of a North West derby . United’s defensive frailties were exposed almost immediately when De Ligt misjudged a long ball, allowing Alexander Isak to sprint through on goal. This error forced Leny Yoro into the desperate challenge that led to his dismissal. Goals from Dominik Szoboszlai and Florian Wirtz soon followed, before Rio Ngumoha and Victor Munoz completed the rout in the second half. Despite the defender appearing slow and lethargic as he struggled with the pace of the game, Pochettino defended the selection following the final whistle. "He was training, he played in the Champions League before the international duty. I think when we arrived, we saw the combination [with Lisandro Martinez]," Pochettino told Sky Sports . Furious boss slams refereeing double standards The game-changing decision left Pochettino absolutely seething, with the manager quick to highlight a glaring double standard in the officiating following an earlier, unpunished penalty shout involving Jeremy Jacquet. Convinced that the referee's inconsistency completely altered the complexion of the match, Pochettino didn't hold back in his post-match assessment. "And I repeat again, Jacquet was a penalty, and if the referee says that is a penalty, for sure that action after never comes, and maybe we talk in another way," a frustrated Pochettino declared. "One centre-back made a mistake, was penalty, wasn't punished, and us, we made one mistake and we were punished. Now I accept all the situation, but the circumstances are the circumstances. It's so important to put the circumstance in front. Always." Reality check for new regime The defeat extends United’s winless streak in the Premier League to nine matches, marking the club's worst-ever run in the competition's history. Pochettino was seen in deep discussion with the officiating crew after the game, though he admitted that his protests would do little to change the outcome of his first match in charge. He emphasized the need for his squad to take responsibility for their performance while remaining critical of the external factors that influenced the game. "I have to defend my club," the Argentine coach stated. "And tell what I feel. That was an action that everyone who plays football, it was clear that a situation that was not a red card." item.title: WWE star LA Knight wants fans to respect ex-girlfriend’s privacy
item.description: WWE star LA Knight wants fans to respect ex-girlfriend’s privacy appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . WWE Superstars are public figures and often find themselves at the receiving end of harsh criticism or trolling. While LA Knight recently opened up and claimed that he had signed up for it, he was not in support of his fans targeting his ex-girlfriend. Knight recently pleaded with wrestling fans to respect other people in his life after fans approached his ex-girlfriend. In a new social media post, the WWE star discussed boundaries with his fans and addressed incidents where fans contacted his ex-girlfriend to accuse him of cheating on her. “All right, let me talk to you. I’m going to say something, and then I’m going to follow it up with a little bit of context. I’m a single man. I’m not married. I’ve never been married. I was in a long-term relationship. That relationship ended in July of 2025. Now, why am I telling you this? I’m telling you this because a lot of you follow me with amazing passion and I appreciate the hell out of that, and in that process, a lot of you found out that I was in a relationship at some point. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) “Now, with that being the case, I kind of keep a pretty standard line here between what I do on TV and my personal life, and I do that on purpose. So when my relationship broke up, I did not see a need to make an announcement to the world that it had ended. However, now it’s gotten to a point where after a couple things, for instance, the WhatsApp group chat that you all were an audience to. You know, there was a Bella Twins, there was an influencer, there was me, and in that process, Nikki and I had exchanged a couple of fun text messages. Some people were like, ‘Oh, isn’t he married?’ And, ‘Doesn’t he have a girlfriend?’ The answer to that is all no, and because you all didn’t know, and that’s fine,” Knight. In the past few years, fans have often crossed boundaries by trying to personally contact WWE Superstars, meet them at airports , or even stalk their houses . However, while Knight’s fans didn’t go to such lengths, he still said that it is not okay for them to contact his former girlfriend. “I signed up to be a public figure. So you can say anything you want to me, good, bad, or indifferent. At the same time, there are real people behind here, and when people are now taking this to my former girlfriend and doing things like that, she didn’t sign up to be a public figure. So that’s all out of bounds. You gotta respect that boundary. You gotta realize that there’s a potential to hurt real people when you’re doing things like that, and in that case, please bring anything you want, any questions or anything, bring it to me,” he added. “But bottom line is, I signed up for that. She did not. Let’s respect that boundary, okay? Deal? Thank you.” Knight is currently set to be a part of the Team USA squad for the upcoming WWE Survivor

item.title: KenPom has a bleak season ahead for Mark Pope and Kentucky Basketball
item.description: LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY - NOVEMBER 13: Mark Pope the head coach oof the Kentucky Wildcats gives instructions to his team against the Northern Arizona Lumberjacks at Rupp Arena on November 13, 2026 in Lexington, Kentucky. (Photo by Andy Lyons/Getty Images) | Getty Images KenPom projections aren’t the be-all, end-all of college basketball, and plenty of teams have made Ken Pomeroy’s algorithm look foolish by the time March rolls around. At the same time, his numbers aren’t something you can simply shrug off and pretend don’t exist either. When a model that tracks every single possession in Division I basketball starts flashing bright red warning lights, it is usually telling you something you already saw with your own eyes. Following Friday night’s 90-76 loss to Indiana in Indianapolis, KenPom released its latest update, and it is the last thing Big Blue Nation wanted to see. Breaking down Kentucky’s latest KenPom numbers Coming into the 2026-27 season, Kentucky sat just outside the KenPom preseason top 25 at No. 26. After early stumbles against Kansas and a narrow escape against Northern Arizona, the Wildcats had already tumbled outside the top 50. The 14-point defeat to the Hoosiers only accelerated the freefall. They are now No. 63 overall, No. 24 in adjusted offense and 131 in adjusted defense. The projected record is now sitting at 16-16 (6-12). That would be a disaster, much like Kentucky’s defense. The Cats can’t keep anyone out of the lane and are almost always in a rotation. And yet, the same defense keeps getting trotted out. Maybe try a zone? It surely couldn’t be much worse. The headline number that hurts the most As ugly as a 16-16 overall projection looks on paper, the real gut punch shows up when you scroll through the game-by-game forecast. Right now, KenPom projects Kentucky to be favored in just one SEC game : South Carolina. Kentucky is projected to be favored in just one SEC game, according to KenPom. pic.twitter.com/fMFy3SUIiN — Jeff Borzello (@jeffborzello) November 21, 2026 Out of an 18-game conference slate, the Wildcats are currently projected as the underdog in 17 of them. Reality vs. the numbers Now, let’s keep some perspective. too. Kentucky is going to win more than one SEC game, and they will probably win more than 8. Basketball isn’t played on a spreadsheet, and even KenPom’s own math agrees, which is why the overall forecast still pegs the Wildcats for a 6-12 conference finish rather than 1-17. Over the course of an 18-game grind, teams steal road games, catch fire at Rupp Arena, and pull off upsets. But the fact that Kentucky could enter almost every single conference game as the underdog is not something that should ever be uttered. Being a slight dog on the road against top-10 caliber SEC heavyweights like Florida, Alabama, or Texas is one thing. But Mississippi State, Vandy, and Ole Miss? Come on. This is Kentucky Basketball. That is simply unacceptable. Mark Pope and his roster still have non-conference opportunitie

item.title: Barcelona suffer massive Lamine Yamal injury blow ahead of Champions League trip
item.description: FC Barcelona v Deportivo Alaves - LaLiga EA Sports 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Lamine Yamal will miss Barcelona's upcoming Champions League fixture against Sabah in Azerbaijan after suffering an ankle injury. The teenage sensation played through the pain barrier to inspire a dramatic comeback against Villarreal, but he has now been sidelined to avoid aggravating the issue. Barcelona suffer Yamal injury blow Barca will be without Yamal for their upcoming Champions League trip to Azerbaijan this week. The 19-year-old forward has been officially ruled out of the crucial European clash against Sabah after suffering an ankle injury. The winger required medical treatment on the issue prior to Sunday's domestic encounter against Villarreal. Despite those initial fitness concerns, he was ultimately deemed fit enough to start the match at Camp Nou. Yamal managed to play the full 90 minutes as Blaugrana secured a dramatic 3-2 comeback victory . However, the club medical staff have now opted to rest him for their midweek European commitments to aid his recovery. Action-packed performance against Villarreal The teenager endured a completely action-packed afternoon against Villarreal before his latest injury status was confirmed. He missed a crucial first-half penalty as Barcelona surprisingly fell into a two-goal deficit on home soil. However, Yamal showcased his elite mentality and was absolutely instrumental in guiding his team back into the contest after the half-time break. He provided the vital assist for Fermín Lopez to score Barca's second goal of the game. The young winger remained a constant attacking threat throughout the second half as the home side chased all three points. He was also heavily involved in the decisive winning goal, which was eventually turned into his own net by Villarreal defender Pau Navarro. Yamal continues incredible individual season Yamal has enjoyed a genuinely electric start to the new campaign for Barcelona. The teenager has already scored 13 goals and provided 13 assists across just 17 appearances for the club so far this season. That exceptional attacking form recently saw the forward finish third in the prestigious Ballon d'Or voting last month. He has also been an incredibly reliable presence, starting 20 matches across all competitions for club and country this term. The attacker previously dealt with a minor knee injury on international duty, which forced him to miss Spain's UEFA Nations League victory over Czechia. However, he returned to action in a defeat to England three days later and reported back to Barcelona completely injury-free. Replacements ready for Baku trip Barcelona must now find a successful way to replace their most productive attacker on the pitch in Baku. The coaching staff have several high-profile options available to rotate into the starting line-up against Sabah. item.title: The Weekend Review: Three remarkable wins
item.description: The Weekend Review: Three remarkable wins It proved to be another memorable weekend for Leeds United. Daniel Farke’s men put rivals Chelsea to the sword while Simon Wood’s women’s team came out on top in a huge top-of-the-table meeting with Halifax Women. There was also a nine-goal thriller for our Under-18s - find out about all the action below. Having not won at Stamford Bridge since 1999, the 4-1 demolition of the Blues was quite the way to buck the trend. United were behind for three minutes after a Chelsea opener, before Noah Okafor’s mazy run and finish drew us level in the capital. A Dominic Calvert-Lewin penalty was followed by another impressive strike by the Swiss attacker, with Brenden Aaronson adding gloss to the scoreline in injury time, sparking wild celebrations in the away end. Speaking afterwards, two-goal hero Okafor said : “I am of course very happy. We knew we would be going into a tough game, so we were here from the first minute on. And, yeah, big compliments to the whole team. They really deserve three points. “It is always nice to score and to have this feeling. It gives confidence, for sure. Like I said already in the last couple of weeks, I feel really comfortable. I play with confidence, play my football and like this I can shine and help the team as much as possible. I did it today again but so happy about the three points.” Leeds United Women went into the clash with Halifax Women with 25 points collected from a possible 27. The Calderdale outfit meanwhile had picked up 18 from 21 available, having played two fewer. The hosts set the tone early on and raced into the lead through Chloe Dixon. The attacker netted twice more on the way to celebrate hat-trick, with a solitary Brittany Sanderson effort completing a 4-2 triumph at the BD Community Stadium. “Absolutely amazing, to be honest with you,” Dixon told LUTV at full-time. “I think every single one of us put in a shift there. That was a real team effort. I think we thoroughly deserved that. It is what you dream of, scoring all the time. But like I said, credit to the team. Without them, they wouldn’t have set me up perfectly most of the time. It got us the win. “I think we got a bit of luck with that first goal but I think it gave us a little bit of breathing space that we probably needed. We had a different formation that we are not used to, so we had to get used to that. Credit to them, great team, but we put in work every week and that is what we want.” On a bitterly cold Friday evening in Guiseley, Scott Gardner’s Under-21s side fell to a narrow defeat against Charlton Athletic Under-21s in the penultimate Premier League Cup Group I fixture. Carrick Njinko netted for the Whites but the game turned on its head in the second half after the hosts were reduced to 10, allowing the Addicks to snatch victory. Gardner wasn’t too despondent however, explaining : “Really proud of the effort the players put in, particularly when we went down to 10 men. I thought we were exc

item.title: “My Tiger” – Carlos Alcaraz’s Younger Brother Jaime, Coco Gauff, Rafael Nadal & Tennis World Share Their Admiration For Spaniard After ATP Finals win
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz © Imagn images Carlos Alcaraz’s maiden ATP Finals victory received an outpouring of admiration from his younger brother Jaime, Coco Gauff, Rafael Nadal, and other tennis stars. Alcaraz faced two-time Grand Slam champion Alexander Zverev. The Spaniard dominated his opponent in the opening set and took early control of the match. Despite entering the final without dropping a set, Zverev struggled against Alcaraz and committed 19 unforced errors in the first set. The German tennis player had saved all six break points in the group stage but struggled against Alcaraz. He managed to win back one break in the first set, but Alcaraz broke him again early in the second. Zverev failed to convert three consecutive set points, allowing Alcaraz to win 6–2, 7–6(9–7). Following the victory, the Spanish tennis ace shared a few glimpses of his run in Turin on Instagram and wrote: “We did it! 🏆” Alcaraz’s post received warm messages from the tennis community, including American tennis star Coco Gauff, who wrote: “Unreal🔥” Jakub Mensik added: “So good, Carlito! 🔥❤️” “Bravooooo,” Eva Lys wrote. Rennae Stubbs added several clapping emojis and wrote, “Yes!” Carlos Alcaraz’s younger brother, Jaime, shared a heartwarming message, highlighting his brother’s winning moments in Turin. “There’s my tiger,” he wrote, adding a heart emoji. Screenshot of Alcaraz’s Instagram post and his brother’s Instagram story. Tennis legend Rafael Nadal also congratulated Alcaraz while acknowledging the tough, injury-ridden year Alcaraz navigated. “Congratulations @carlosalcaraz on winning the @atptour Finals! I know it’s been a tough year, and I’m so happy you were able to win this important tournament while playing so well. Good luck in the Davis Cup now! 💪🏻” Carlos Alcaraz suffered a wrist injury during his Barcelona Open run, which kept him off the court for more than four months. Carlos Alcaraz opens up on being asked if he thinks he is the best player in the world In the press conference following his maiden ATP Finals title, Carlos Alcaraz was asked whether he believes he is the best player in the world despite being No. 3. “Well, no, not at all. But what I’m going to say is I think everybody feels he’s the number one. Me, Sasha, Jannik, Shelton, I think everybody thinks they are the number one in the world. And I think that confidence is…it’s really important. Having that confidence in yourself, it’s… It’s really important when you hit the practice score, when you hit the match. It’s really important to have that confidence in yourself. But you know, the number one is Sasha. He truly deserves it. Nobody’s going to take that position and the number one away from him. We have to think about it. We have to say that right now the ranking says it’s Sasha, and we have to give credit to him.” (6:35 onwards) Zverev’s rise to the top ranking stems from his first two Grand Slam titles at the French Open and US Open, and a Wimbledon final appearance. item.title: Stoke City 1-0 Birmingham City - fans' verdict
item.description: [BBC] We asked for your thoughts after Stoke City beat Birmingham City 1-0 on Saturday to knock Blues off the summit of the Championship and move joint-top with Middlesbrough. Here are some of your comments: Potters fans Mark: Stoke written off by every pundit at the open of the season, gave all the doubters a three-game head start and then began their ascent. May it continue all the way. MD : Stoke were the better side and deserved the win. Stoke started stronger but let Birmingham into the game later in the first half through sloppy play. Stoke came out strong again in the second half and Birmingham only got into the game after the sending off. The ref was poor and wanted to get involved too much. He didn't need to book so many players as it wasn't a dirty game. Jeff : Awesome, especially given the very poor refereeing! Anthony : Stoke were fantastic. With 11 men we were on top, with 10 we stayed on top. Everyone was up for the fight and the crowd were tremendous as well. Something is happening and I hope we keep it going. George Hirst celebrates scoring Stoke's winner against Birmingham [Getty Images] Blues fans Les : Awful, no place in the Premier League if you can't take 10 men to pieces. Martin : Tame, too many unforced changes, pathetic response against 10 men. Brad : As soon as the team was announced I felt we could be in trouble, we were slow and lethargic from the off, Iwata and Paik does not work. Even when Stoke went down to 10, we never looked like getting back into the game. Would love to know what Samuel has done wrong, I felt he was one of our best players this season so far so to be dropped (not rested) for Laird is confusing, he was at fault for the goal and was pretty average at best. Trevor : Lacklustre display. Blues again showed their inability to move the ball quickly from back to front and through the lines. Quality of crosses into the box was very, very poor.

item.title: Patriots expected to show interest in Daniel Jones, but there’s a catch
item.description: With their season at a crossroads in light of the fractured fibula suffered by starting quarterback Drake Maye, the New England Patriots are exploring the possibility of adding another passer to the mix. One name to keep an eye on is Daniel Jones, who was let go by the Indianapolis Colts on Friday . Jones, 29, was placed on waivers, meaning that any team has the opportunity to claim him. However, according to a report by Ian Rapoport of NFL Network, that is not expected to happen. And once he makes it through the wire and to the open market, the Patriots are among the teams expected to take a look at him. “The Patriots along with the Baltimore Ravens and maybe the Arizona Cardinals are expected to have interest in the recently-waived former Colts starter,” Rapoport said on the air on Sunday. “He goes on waivers. We find out 4 p.m. on Monday whether or not anyone claims him. Unlikely because of the $2 million due this year, $10 million guaranteed for injury next year.” With Maye potentially missing the next six weeks , if not more, the Patriots are looking at a starter-backup combination of Tommy DeVito and rookie Behren Morton. Adding Jones to the mix would therefore make sense given his experience in the NFL and the fact that he has played some winning football previously in his career. However, there is a catch: the former first-round draft pick appears to be willing to wait for the right opportunity to come along. “If he clears [waivers], my understanding is that Daniel Jones is expected to wait,” Rapoport said. “Just to wait, see if there’s another quarterback injury. Of course, if there was, he would be the first call of any playoff team needing a quarterback.” If Jones is indeed in no rush to sign with a team, the Patriots’ interest might just start to evaporate. At 5-5 and the current eighth playoff seed in the AFC, they simply might not have time to wait for Jones. Instead, they might just try their luck with DeVito — who is in his second year in the system — rather than try to bring Jones aboard late and then try to get him up to starter-caliber speed. The Patriots, with DeVito currently atop their quarterback depth chart, will visit the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 12.

item.title: Insecurity: Tinubu directed me to sustain operations, secure Yorubaland against foreign terrorists – Igboho
item.description: …says President called for collaboration with security agencies to protect rural communities, urban centres, forests By Adeola Badru Yoruba nation activist and founder of the Iru Ekun Security Network, Chief Sunday Adeyemo, popularly known as Sunday Igboho, has disclosed that President Bola Tinubu directed him to sustain security operations across Yorubaland, with particular emphasis on protecting rural communities, urban centres and forests against terrorists from neighbouring African countries. Igboho said the president gave the directive during a brief discussion lasting about five minutes inside his official car shortly after the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rally held at Mapo Hall, Ibadan, the Oyo State capital, on Saturday. According to him, Tinubu also emphasised the need for the Iru Ekun Security Network to maintain effective collaboration with the Nigeria Police Force, the Nigerian Army, the Department of State Services (DSS) and other relevant security agencies to prevent the infiltration of terrorists and other criminal elements into the South-West. Igboho disclosed this in a statement issued by his media office on Monday, which quoted him as saying that the President’s directive was aimed at strengthening security across the region, particularly in rural settlements, urban centres and forest reserves. He said, “After the Ibadan Presidential Campaign Council (PCC) rally on Saturday, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu called me into his car and instructed me to continue working with security agencies to ensure peace and stability in the South-West.” “I was honoured by our President on Saturday when I had a brief discussion with him inside his official car before the presidential convoy moved out of the ancient Mapo Hall premises, Ibadan.” “It vividly shows that Mr. President values our selfless efforts to galvanise and improve security and safety of our people.” The Yoruba activist said the discussion, although brief, highlighted the importance the president attached to the security of the Southwest and the continued activities of the homegrown security initiative. “Our discussion lasted for about five minutes. Mr President directed that we must sustain our operations by securing rural communities, urban centres and our forests in Yorubaland against terrorists from neighbouring African countries,” he said. Igboho added that Tinubu specifically stressed the importance of cooperation between the Iru Ekun Security Network and established security agencies in tackling criminal activities across the region. item.title: Fire Destroys Over 100 Shops At Kano Fish Market, Traders Count Losses
item.description: A fire outbreak at Kano Fish Market along Zaria Road has destroyed more than 100 shops, leaving traders counting losses estimated to run into billions of naira. The fire reportedly broke out at about 9:00 p.m. on Sunday, near Kano Line Motor Park, spreading across sections of the market and destroying shops, containers and goods. Reports indicate that approximately 150 shops and 200 containers were affected by the inferno, with some traders reportedly losing goods valued at millions of naira. Traders trying to salvage what is left after the fire One of the affected traders, Usman Sani, recounted how the fire spread through the market, destroying shops and goods before traders could salvage their belongings. “We received the news of the fire and rushed to the market, but by the time we got here, the flames had already spread. Many shops were affected, and traders lost goods worth millions of naira. The situation is heartbreaking,” he said. The huge fire on Sunday, November 22, 2026, as it razes the fish shop in Kano State. Another trader, Musa Inuwa, described the incident as a major setback for those who depend on the market for their livelihood. “Many of us depend entirely on this business to feed our families. We have lost our goods and capital, and we do not know where to start from. We are appealing to the government to come to our assistance,” he said. The affected traders are appealing to the Kano State Government and relevant authorities for urgent intervention to support those who lost their businesses. The Kano State Fire Service reportedly received a distress call at about 9:58 p.m. and deployed personnel to the scene, arriving four minutes later. Meanwhile, the cause of the fire remains unknown, as investigations continue. The post Fire Destroys Over 100 Shops At Kano Fish Market, Traders Count Losses appeared first on Channels Television .

item.title: OKC nail artist's TikTok went viral. Now she does Jared McCain's nails
item.description: When Jared McCain was traded to the Oklahoma City Thunder, Yvie McCrary saw more than basketball news. She saw a potential client. The Oklahoma City nail artist took her shot on TikTok, posting a video in hopes of catching McCain's attention. It went viral. He saw it. And soon, the NBA guard known for his elaborate manicures was sitting at McCrary's nail table. Months later, McCrary painted McCain's nails gold for Thunder media day . When he flashed them to The Oklahoman during a news conference, video of the manicure generated more than a million views on the NBA's social account. It was quite a leap for an artist barely three years into her career. And another sign of how nail art, long coded as feminine, is finding an increasingly visible place in men's fashion, including among professional athletes. McCain first found an interest in nail artistry during the COVID-19 pandemic, in his early years of high school. With nothing to do at home, he saw others do it online and decided to give it a try. "I liked the way it looked, and it became a unique part of something that I do, and now it's just part of me," McCain told The Oklahoman during OKC Thunder media day. Before he was playing professional basketball, he was already finding ways to bring nail art onto the court. During the basketball playoffs in high school, McCain painted his nails with the logo of each team his team defeated. By the time they won the championship, all five fingers represented stops along the title run. The hobby followed McCain to the NBA. He was drafted by the Philadelphia 76ers in the 2024 NBA Draft and later traded to Oklahoma City in February 2026. It has also become part of his brand. In a sports world filled with Nike, Adidas and Jordan partnerships, McCain has a deal with nail polish brand Sally Hansen. But when McCain arrived in Oklahoma City, he still needed someone to actually do his nails. That's where McCrary came in. OKC nail artist shoots her shot McCrary had just celebrated her two-year "nail birthday," as she calls it, when she learned McCain was headed to Oklahoma City. McCrary posted a TikTok for fun, with hopes of getting the shooting guard's attention, and after the video went viral, it landed on McCain’s feed. "He messaged me and wanted to come get nails; that was pretty cool for me," McCrary said. McCrary started cosmetology school in 2022, dreaming of becoming a hair stylist, but as part of the course, she needed to take a nail class. McCrary didn't think she was going to like it at first, but fell in love with the art once she got into it. "It's so versatile," McCrary said. "You can get pretty creative with it. ... A lot of people get single colors or clean girl nails and I'm like, 'Nope!' I like all the art; I like to do all the crazy fun things." item.title: Why Aaron Rodgers refused to share a message for ‘good friend’ DK Metcalf after ejection
item.description: Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images Aaron Rodgers kept his message for DK Metcalf hidden. The Pittsburgh Steelers failed to register a win against the struggling Philadelphia Eagles as they were handed a 19-16 defeat at Lincoln Financial Field. A major turning point in the game was Steelers WR DK Metcalf getting ejected during the second half over an altercation with Eagles CB Cooper DeJean. The Steelers Nation was understandably upset as they have now fallen to a 6-4 record for the season. Aaron Rodgers hides his message for DK Metcalf from NFL media Considering Metcalf’s ejection turned the tide against the Steelers, the media asked for star QB Aaron Rodgers’ thoughts on the moment. Rodgers didn’t give a straight answer, however, and told the media that he would share his message personally with Metcalf. “I’m not going to tell you that. I’ll talk to DK. We’re real good friends,” Rodgers told reporters. No matter what Rodgers had said about Metcalf, it would have made headlines and brought further problems for Metcalf. In hindsight, it was a good decision, but Rodgers didn’t look happy by any means, as his facial expressions showed clear frustration with the Steelers’ struggles this season. item.title: Chelsea eye double winter swoop for Monaco's Lamine Camara and Bournemouth's Alex Scott despite Liverpool threat
item.description: Liverpool FC v AS Monaco - Pre-Season Friendly - Getty Images Sport Chelsea are considering a January double swoop for Monaco midfielder Lamine Camara and Bournemouth star Alex Scott as they look to reinforce their engine room. Despite facing serious competition from Premier League rivals Liverpool, officials in west London remain confident of convincing both players to join them in the New Year. Blues target two midfield additions TEAMtalk reports that Chelsea have not ruled out signing both Camara and Scott when the transfer window reopens. The Blues' lack of midfield depth was exposed at the weekend when Moises Caicedo suffered an early injury during their 4-1 defeat to Leeds United . Recruitment chiefs believe the pair offer different tactical qualities in central midfield, despite both operating in similar areas. Summer collapse fails to deter Chelsea originally targeted Camara late in the summer window as they scrambled to replace Enzo Fernandez following his move to Manchester City. A transfer had been lined up with Monaco before the Principality club pulled the plug at the last minute , sparking considerable annoyance inside Stamford Bridge. However, the report states that Chelsea have not held that collapsed deal against the Senegalese international himself. Club officials have remained in regular contact with his camp and closely tracked his progress throughout the current campaign, with Camara responding impressively by playing every single minute of Monaco's Ligue 1 season so far. Liverpool threat complicates winter pursuit Alongside their ongoing pursuit of Camara, Chelsea have also been making steady progress on a prospective deal for Scott. The outlet adds that Bournemouth are ready to do business on the midfielder after he rejected numerous offers to extend his current contract at the Vitality Stadium. Winning the race for either target will not be straightforward, as both players are widely expected to be on the move in January and are attracting major interest from across the top flight. Liverpool are known to be huge admirers of the midfield duo, with Anfield boss Andoni Iraola keen to boost his own options, setting up a potential New Year tug-of-war. Despite that threat, Chelsea remain confident both players would opt for west London if given the choice. January battle awaits rival clubs Chelsea must first assess the severity of Caicedo's injury while trying to recover from their heavy defeat at Leeds. Behind the scenes, sporting directors will need to move decisively before January to fend off Iraola's Liverpool in negotiations with Monaco and Bournemouth. Landing both midfielders would immediately transform Chelsea's squad depth for the second half of the campaign.

item.title: Marc Marquez makes history, Valentino Rossi keeps revisiting it
item.description: Motorsport photo In one of those curious twists of fate, Marquez sealed his eighth MotoGP world title at Portimo just as Rossi was touring Italy to promote his autobiography, La Mia Storia , which was released on 10 November. Throughout those appearances, mainly on television and radio programmes, references to Marquez were a constant feature, subsequently picked up and amplified by the media. Not only by the specialist publications, but also by plenty of others with little connection to motorcycle racing, unwilling to pass up the opportunity to cash in on some particularly lucrative clicks. As for the substance of Rossi's message, there was nothing new: he was simply reiterating his long-held views on Marquez. The same views he has repeated for the past 11 years, ever since the 'Sepang Clash', the incident that forever divided the motorcycling world into Rossi and Marquez camps, and about which far too much has already been said and written. Ever since the Spaniard burst onto the MotoGP scene like a thunderbolt in 2013, he has been competing with the Italian for just about everything. On the track, for points, victories and titles. Off it, for the right to occupy the throne reserved for the rider regarded as the GOAT – the greatest of all time. That particular contest is impossible to settle if statistics – which now favour Marquez – are taken out of the equation, because any judgement is entirely subjective, shaped by personal opinions, admiration and allegiances towards either rider. With Rossi having retired five years ago and Marquez still winning, if there is one thing that continues to set them against each other, it is the narrative. Or, more precisely, the way that narrative is manipulated. As 'The Doctor' himself has acknowledged in recent days, he has still not recovered from the bitter disappointment of 2015. "It's something that doesn't go away; it still hurts. More than 10 years have passed, but the feeling and my state of mind when I think back to it are exactly the same as they were that night in Valencia, and that worries me a little," he admitted just a few days ago, during one of his many promotional appearances. It was a disappointment which, it is worth remembering, came after Rossi had pursued a disastrous strategy, seemingly devised by his worst enemy or, at the very least, by someone with a remarkable lack of judgement. The plan succeeded in reawakening a Marquez who had nothing left to play for in a championship that had already become an exclusively Yamaha affair. It also gave the then-Honda rider an extraordinarily powerful reason to demonstrate the strength of his character, despite being just 22 years old, when anyone – absolutely anyone, even motorcycling's biggest global icon – dared to question his integrity. item.title: UK Digging New Reservoirs To Fight Persistent Droughts
item.description: Britain has long had a reputation for rain. But as it adapts to a warmer, drier climate, the UK is racing to complete a huge new reservoir, its first in over three decades. Bulldozers have been digging up the ground for the vast £800-million ($1 billion) Havant Thicket project near the southern coastal port of Portsmouth. Like much of Europe, Britain endured record-breaking heat this summer and, despite the return of rains as the country moves into winter, parts are still grappling with drought conditions. “We’ve got increasing problems with our water security in the UK,” climate scientist Hannah Cloke from Reading University told AFP. “We need to really think about how we’re storing that water because this problem is only going to get worse.” Scientists have warned extreme weather events are likely to become more frequent and more intense as the global climate changes. Workers carry out construction work at the site of the new Havant Thicket Reservoir in Hampshire, southern England, on November 5, 2026. Photo by CARLOS JASSO / AFP By mid-November, almost all of England remained in drought, with some areas classified as suffering severe drought, according to the Environment Agency. Potentially exacerbating matters, existing reservoirs were only 60 percent full, 19 percentage points below the seasonal average. For policymakers, the situation poses a longer-term challenge as the thirst for water increases with a rising population and the growth of heavy water-using industries such as data centres. Under England’s National Framework for Water Resources published in 2025, the country could face a daily water supply shortfall of five billion litres (1.3 billion gallons) by 2055, with resources under pressure. At the sprawling Havant Thicket site, Portsmouth Water chief executive Bob Taylor said the industry was waking up to the scale of the challenge after successive droughts and hot summers. Workers carry out construction work at the site of the new Havant Thicket Reservoir in Hampshire, southern England, on November 5, 2026. Photo by CARLOS JASSO / AFP The issue, he stressed, was not necessarily how much rain falls over the course of a year, but when it falls. Winters are becoming wetter, while summers are increasingly dry. “Without reservoirs you can’t store that intense rainfall and put it somewhere where it can be used at another time,” Taylor said. The new reservoir will eventually hold up to 8.7 billion litres of water, helping secure supplies for hundreds of thousands of people. Fed in part by winter surpluses from a major spring already tapped by Portsmouth Water, it has become one of the flagship projects in a broader shift in Britain’s water strategy. The government has approved the construction of nine major reservoirs by 2050, and last year relaxed planning rules to speed up projects after decades of under-investment in water infrastructure. Together, the future reservoirs could deliver an additional 670 million litres of water per day. ‘

item.title: Astronomers just discovered a rare triple star system 28 light-years away, and they have ‘no clean explanation for how it got here’
item.description: A triple system containing a dim red dwarf star and not one but two white dwarfs has been fortuitously discovered just 28 light-years away from our solar system. "We were actually looking for planets ," Étienne Artigau of the Trottier Institute for Research on Exoplanets at the Université de Montréal, who led the discovery, said in a statement . "Instead, we found something much more surprising." So surprising that there are no similar systems within at least 100 light-years . Furthermore, the configuration of the system seems impossible. "This system should not exist," added Montreal's Patrick Dufour. "We have no clean explanation for how it got here." This triple system has been called Welopō'ai, which is a portmanteau of two Hawaiian words that means a 'path of family traits', and to understand the mystery behind it requires astronomers to figure out the history of the three objects. A white dwarf is what remains when a star of similar mass to our sun reaches the end of its life. As it begins to run low on hydrogen for nuclear fusion reactions in its core, the star's energy generation begins to falter and its interior starts to contract under gravity . This has the effect of raising the temperature throughout the star, causing an outer shell of hydrogen to ignite its own fusion reactions. The star promptly bloats to become a red giant tens or even hundreds of millions of kilometers across. Soon enough the star ceases fusion reactions completely. The star's outer layers are shed and they expand out into space, while its core contracts to become an inert white dwarf with a diameter similar to Earth but with a mass generally between half and two-thirds of a solar mass . Therefore, the Welopō'ai system was once a triple system with two sun-like stars plus the red dwarf. Now the two sun-like stars have undergone this stage of star death while their companion red dwarf continues to linger, since its low mass bequeaths it a longer life because it does not use up its core hydrogen as quickly. One of the white dwarfs orbits the red dwarf at a distance of 129.3 astronomical units (19.3 billion kilometers or 12 billion miles) and takes about 1,000 years to complete one orbit. This white dwarf and the red dwarf were previously known, and Artigau's team had been using the SPectropolarimètre InfraROUge (SPIRou) instrument on the Canada–France–Hawaii Telescope atop Mauna Kea to search for planets orbiting the red dwarf when they noticed something highly unusual. Observations of the Welopō'ai triple-star system, located 28 light-years from Earth. The image on the left shows the two components of the system: Welopō'ai A, a closely orbiting red dwarf and white dwarf pair, and Welopō'ai B, a second white dwarf located much farther away. The image on the right provides a close-up view of the inner pair, revealing the faint white dwarf companion (Ab) detected using the Gemini North telescope's 'Alopeke instrument. item.title: Chiefs News: George Karlaftis continues impressive run of sacks
item.description: (Photo by David Eulitt/Getty Images) | Getty Images Outside of one drive, the Kansas City Chiefs suffocated the Arizona Cardinals ’ offense during the 34-7 victory in Week 11. That relentless effort was led by Mr. Relentless himself, defensive end George Karlaftis. He had 2.5 sacks, a forced fumble and three other quarterback hits. He has now produced eight sacks this season, all since Week 6. After the game, head coach Andy Reid was asked about what the secret sauce has been for Karlaftis this year. “He got married,” Reid joked. “His wife’s actually a better athlete than he is; we’ll sign his kids right now.” “Listen, George is all business,” Reid continued. “He’s smart, tough… relentless… he’s not the flashiest guy, but he’s going to keep breaking it on you. item.title: Ravens drop 6th straight to Panthers, put season on life support
item.description: The Baltimore Ravens dropped their sixth straight game in a rollicking, back-and-forth 35-33 loss to the Carolina Panthers on Sunday afternoon. After a wild 58 minutes that included seven lead changes and no less than a dozen jaw-dropping plays, Carolina took the lead on a Ryan Fitzgerald field goal with 1:47 to go. Baltimore’s potential game-winning drive was snuffed out by a Jacoby Brissett interception, and the Ravens dropped to 4-7 . The currently sit 11th in the AFC – and in the 2027 draft order. That is starting to sound like a good thing for a team that should be considering major changes this offseason. The Ravens defense gave up the lead four different times on Sunday afternoon, including twice directly after scores from the offense. The offense turned the ball over twice and gained just eight yards across their first three drives of the second half. And outside of a Devontez Walker kickoff return touchdown, Baltimore’s special teams units struggled with sloppy ball-handling and poor coverage. And yet, the Ravens had two distinct chances to win this game late in the fourth quarter. The first was the Panthers’ penultimate drive, in which Baltimore’s defense could not dig their heels in and protect a one-point lead. Brissett’s gunslinging on the previous drive showed he was capable of driving into field goal range, but another collapse in pass protection forced him to throw a prayer out of bounds to avoid a sack. Except the pass did not make it to the sidelines, instead landing in the arms of Panthers linebacker Tyrel Dodson. In both instances, the Ravens could not be at their best when their best was needed. Despite thrilling wins over the Cowboys and Falcons, first-year head coach Jesse Minter’s oft-repeated mantra never fully took root in The Castle. And it is fair to question if he has lived up to his own standard. Brissett was rushing partially because Minter declined to take a timeout after a sack with 1:30 to go. 24 seconds later, Brissett threw a checkdown to Justice Hill to set up a 4th-and-1. Only then did Minter stop the clock, only for Brissett to restart it with a sneak that chewed up another 23 seconds before the pick. This is the second game in a row that Minter’s questionable timeout usage has costed the Ravens precious time in end-of-half situations – two contests that were decided by a total of five points. At the end of the day, the coaching staff is failing simple math problems – and struggling to keep their finger on the pulse of the game. To be fair, that pulse was all over the play. To borrow a phrase from a Saturday Night Live great, this game had everything: a replay-assisted safety; a wildcat flea flicker touchdown; a fumble out of the end zone, a muffed punt, and Walker’s return touchdown – all from the Ravens, all in the first 20 minutes. Per @espn research: The Ravens are the second team in the last 20 years to lose a game despite producing a safety and a kick return TD. They join Washington, who lost in Week 1

item.title: Do you think Bayern Munich’s makeshift lineup would have a chance vs. LOSC Lille?
item.description: (Photo by Harry Langer/DeFodi Images/DeFodi via Getty Images) | DeFodi Images via Getty Images Bayern Munich may have to get creative in a hurry when Wednesday’s Champions League clash with Lille rolls around. With Harry Kane, Serge Gnabry, and Ismael Saibari among the attacking absentees, Vincent Kompany co uld be forced into a rather unconventional lineup to get through the game, especially because of the uncertainty surrounding Michael Olise and Luis Díaz. According to Bild , the current likeliest attacking combination would feature Nathaniel Brown on the left wing, Tim Binder on the rig ht wing, Tom Bischof operating as the No. 10, and Lennart Karl at striker. That is certai nly not the attacking quartet Bayern would have drawn up at the start of the season, and it would require several players to shoulder unfamiliar responsibilities on a ma ssive European stage. Yes, Bayern Munich still has enough talent, tactical structure, and individual quality to make this work. Karl has shown flashes of enormous potential, Bischof offers technical ability and creativity, and the opportunity could allow some lesse r-used players to make their mark. Even with the attacking absences, Bayern Munich should still have plenty of strength in the middle of the pitc h and defensively to help offset the situation. Joshua Kimmich, Aleksandar Pavlović, and potentially other midfield options give Bayern a combination of experi ence, control, and technical quality that can dictate the tempo and keep Lille from gaining too much momentum. Defensively, Dayot Upamecano, Jonathan Ta h, and Kim Min-jae provide plenty of quality and depth at center-back, while the fullback options can still offer stability despite Alphonso Davies being unavailable. Bayern Munich may be short on firepower up front, but the spine of this team remains strong enough to give th em a fighting chance of controlling the ma tch. Lille, however, isn’t going to politely accommodate FC Bayern’s injury problems. An improvised front line, limited familiarity, and the absence of proven attacking firepower could make for a very long night in the final third. What do you think? item.title: Giants QB Jameis Winston restrains teammate Malik Nabers during angry moment on the touchline
item.description: Photo by Scott Taetsch/Getty Images New York Giants QB Jameis Winston’s veteran instincts kicked in during a heated moment involving 23-year-old WR Malik Nabers during their 23-18 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars. The Giants are proving to be more competitive than many had assumed before the season, with their 6-3-1 record putting them in pole position to secure the NFC East and a spot in the playoffs one season after going 4-13. One of the key reasons for this turnaround has been WR Nabers, who tore his ACL last season. While Nabers is impressing fans on the field with his raw prowess and route-running skills, he also needs to ensure he stays level-headed and focused on winning. Malik Nabers needed to be calmed down by Jameis Winston during Giants win With under six minutes left in this closely poised contest, Nabers was visibly upset on the touchline when the Giants’ defence was on the field, with backup QB Winston restraining the young WR. This situation has since been downplayed, as neither Nabers nor Winston had anything negative to say about the seemingly tense confrontation. Nabers claims to have just been saying he was good while passionately cheering the defence on from the touchline. It seems to be a moment of excessive passion flowing out in the middle of a close game between two teams that hope to make runs in the playoffs. Nabers went 7/12 on receptions for 55 yards and one touchdown in this game. He has gone 65/97 all season for 747 receiving yards and three TDs. He is looking like he’s back to peak fitness and willing to do anything to help the Giants add to their win column. Winston was the Giants’ starting QB earlier this season after Jaxson Dart was ruled out for the season after Week 2. He has since transitioned into a backup/mentor role after the team acquired former first-round pick J.J. McCarthy from the Minnesota Vikings. The passion on display from Nabers and the leadership from Winston both are great signs for a once-proud franchise hoping to become a competitive force again. Instead, John is pivoting to Randy Arozarena, who has already been tied to the Yankees in some rumors. item.title: Pens Points: Stars blank rudderless Penguins
item.description: DALLAS, TX - NOVEMBER 22: Joel Kiviranta #22 and Wyatt Johnston #53 of the Dallas Stars celebrates a goal with team against the Pittsburgh Penguins at the American Airlines Center on November 22, 2026 in Dallas, Texas. (Photo by Glenn James/NHLI via Getty Images) | NHLI via Getty Images Here are your Pens Points for this Monday morning… The Pittsburgh Penguins were shut out by the Dallas Stars, 1-0, Sunday night, extending their losing streak to four games. Arturs Silovs made 24 saves for Pittsburgh, which struggled to generate offense despite hitting the post multiple times and going 0-for-2 on the power play. [ Recap ] Forward Rickard Rakell continues to show his commitment to the team despite a difficult season and growing trade speculation. [ Trib Live ] News and notes from around the NHL… The Dylan Larkin trade saga is officially over, ending with a blockbuster deal. The Montreal Canadiens have acquired Larkin from the Detroit Red Wings. Detroit receives forward Kirby Dach, goaltender Samuel Montembeault, prospect Michael Hage and four draft picks, including first-round selections in 2027 and 2029, while Montreal also receives Detroit’s second-round pick in 2028 and third-round pick in 2027. [ NHL ] The Toronto Maple Leafs will not loan rookie forward Gavin McKenna to Team Canada for the 2026 IIHF World Junior Championship, according to Sportsnet’s Elliotte Friedman. [ Sportsnet ] Chicago Blackhawks captain Connor Bedard has been placed on injured reserve as the young forward prepares to undergo right shoulder surgery after suffering an injury during a faceoff in last Tuesday’s win over the Maple Leafs. The 21-year-old, who leads Chicago with 18 points in 15 games, has no timetable for his return and now stands to miss more time following his third shoulder injury in less than a year. item.title: Yankees Lose 28-Year-Old Outfielder To Rival Red Sox In Free Agency
item.description: BALTIMORE, MARYLAND - APRIL 29: A view of the New York Yankees logo on a ball bag before the game against the Baltimore Orioles at Oriole Park at Camden Yards on April 29, 2025 in Baltimore, Maryland. (Photo by G Fiume/Getty Images) Getty Images The New York Yankees have already begun shaping their roster for next season, bringing back closer David Bednar on a qualifying offer and agreeing to a one-year contract with left-handed reliever Tim Hill. The Yankees have also seen several organizational players reach free agency, creating opportunities for rival clubs to capitalize on the available talent. While much of the attention surrounding New York’s offseason will understandably center on its major league roster, losing a depth option to a division rival can add another wrinkle to the club’s plans. That is particularly true when the player in question brings a specific skill set that could help another American League contender, as outfield speedster Duke Ellis has by joining the hated rival Boston Red Sox. “The Red Sox have agreed to a minor league deal with OF Duke Ellis, pending physical,” 7News’ Ari Alexander reported . “The deal is split, with $1 million in MLB, or $70k over minimum, whichever is greater.” FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Blue Jays, Tigers Castoff Leaves MLB Immediately After Cut Boston Red Sox Acquire New York Yankees Free Agents Ellis, 28, spent the 2026 season in the Yankees organization, appearing in 99 games with Triple-A Scranton/Wilkes-Barre. He hit .276/.341/.397 with five home runs, 26 RBI and 60 stolen bases, providing the organization with a particularly valuable speed threat. Ellis has also received opportunities in the major leagues, appearing in 11 games between the Chicago White Sox and Yankees in 2024. He recorded five stolen bases in those appearances, although he has yet to establish himself as a regular major league contributor. But Boston’s decision to bring Ellis aboard gives the organization another option in center field, where his speed and defensive versatility could eventually become useful. The Red Sox have an opportunity to evaluate him during spring training before determining whether he can contribute at the major league level. “In 2027, Ellis will serve as that speedy, center field depth for the Red Sox instead of the Yankees,” Leo Morgenstern noted for MLB Trade Rumors . “It’s unlikely he’ll break the big league roster out of spring training, but if he makes it to Boston at any point during the year, he’ll get to contribute to what should be one of the best defensive outfields in the majors.” FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Yankees Acquire Switch-Hitting Red Sox Outfielder After Trent Grisham Exit New York Yankees Could Face Castoff Outfielder With Boston Red Sox For the Yankees, Ellis’ departure is unlikely to dramatically alter their offseason plans. item.title: Shane Beamer’s Postgame Exchange With LaNorris Sellers Raises a Bigger Question for South Carolina’s Future
item.description: Nov 21, 2026; Columbia, South Carolina, USA; South Carolina Gamecocks head coach Shane Beamer looks on during the first half against the Georgia Bulldogs at Williams-Brice Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Jeff Blake-Imagn Images Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect (Reuters) COLUMBIA, S.C. — South Carolina’s 34-6 loss to No. 1 Georgia on Saturday night was disappointing enough. However, an exchange during the postgame news conference quickly shifted attention toward another question surrounding the Gamecocks’ future. Head coach Shane Beamer faced questions about why quarterback LaNorris Sellers did not participate in Senior Night festivities before the game. The explanation drew attention, particularly because Sellers is listed as a senior on South Carolina’s official roster. Now, with the regular season nearing its conclusion, the situation has added another layer of uncertainty surrounding one of the program’s most important players. Beamer’s explanation draws attention after Georgia loss South Carolina recognized 20 seniors before Saturday’s home finale at Williams-Brice Stadium. However, Sellers was not among the players who participated. When reporters asked the quarterback about his absence, Beamer stepped in before Sellers could finish answering. “I made that decision,” Beamer said. The coach explained that Sellers, despite preparing to graduate, still has another season of eligibility remaining. However, reporters questioned the distinction because other players with remaining eligibility participated in the ceremony. Beamer acknowledged uncertainty about Sellers’ official roster classification and accepted responsibility for the decision. The exchange quickly generated discussion about the program’s handling of the situation. Beamer addresses the situation again Sunday Beamer returned to the subject during his weekly teleconference Sunday evening. He acknowledged that his original explanation had not been clear. “I did a poor job of communicating last night,” Beamer said. The clarification followed widespread discussion of the exchange and the circumstances surrounding Sellers’ absence from the ceremony. However, the situation does not establish that Sellers has made a decision about his future. Instead, it highlights an important question South Carolina must address as the season approaches its conclusion. What does this mean for LaNorris Sellers’ future? Sellers has another season of college eligibility available. That leaves several possibilities for the quarterback after the season, including returning to South Carolina, exploring a transfer or pursuing an NFL opportunity. However, Sellers has not publicly announced a final decision about those options. His absence from Senior Night does not guarantee that he will return to the Gamecocks. Likewise, the postgame exchange does not establish that he intends to leave. Nevertheless, his decision will have significant implications for South Carolina’s offensive plans. item.title: Manchester City have no plans to move Gianluigi Donnarumma on and remain confident the Italy international can rediscover his best form, despite a string of mistakes and mounting calls for him to be dropped.
item.description: Manchester City have no plans to move Gianluigi Donnarumma on and remain confident the Italy international can rediscover his best form, despite a string of mistakes and mounting calls for him to be dropped. Gianluigi Donnarumma has endured a difficult period of form lately. More Videos Across a torrid run of form, perhaps none of Enzo Maresca's players have drawn as much criticism as Gianluigi Donnarumma. A series of costly errors have dragged the Manchester City goalkeeper’s stock to an all-time low, and with the January window edging closer, whispers about his long-term future have begun to grow. Inevitably, some have wondered whether the club might look to cut their losses and reshape their goalkeeping department in the summer, with a number of options including Lens’ Robin Risser linked in recent weeks. The reality behind the scenes, however, appears rather less dramatic than the speculation would suggest. Man City stand by their number one Journalist Pete O’Rourke has revealed that City remain fully committed to Donnarumma and have no intention of letting him leave. Despite the recent dip, the Blues are confident the Italian can recapture the form that established him as one of the finest goalkeepers on the planet and he will retain his standing as Enzo Maresca’s undisputed first choice. This means that the club’s position behind the scenes aligns with everything Maresca has said in public, most recently throwing his weight behind his number one behind Saturday’s home draw against Fulham . Acknowledging Donnarumma’s recent mistakes in his pre-match press, Maresca nonetheless confirmed the 27-year-old would start against the Cottagers, where he was individually solid despite the disappointing result. The stance is a firm rebuttal of suggestions elsewhere that Manchester City could move Donnarumma on in 2027 as director of football Hugo Viana and co navigate potential ramifications of the independent panel's guilty verdict on the club's business in the transfer markets to follow. The 27-year-old has already been responsible for four errors leading to goals for club and country this term, and fans can point to the defeats at Villa Park and at home to Paris Saint-Germain in particular as times that his poor form has cost City at crucial stages of games. While City’s stance will obviously need to be reevaluated if this pattern continues, there is no sense of an imminent change. Gerónimo Rulli is the man next in line following James Trafford’s departure, but the Argentine is very much seen as a cup ‘keeper, and a two-time Yashin Trophy winner of Donnarumma’s calibre is not about to be discarded lightly. The numbers behind the dip Donnarumma’s save percentage has fallen from 72.9 per cent last season to around 65.8 per cent across the opening ten games of this campaign, while his goals conceded per 90 minutes have climbed from 0.85 to 1.3. item.title: Alex Freeman: Man United make major decision on January move for USMNT star
item.description: Alex Freeman: Man United make major decision on January move for USMNT star Manchester United’s defensive issues were laid bare in the 4-0 defeat to Liverpool in the Premier League on Sunday, 22 November at Anfield. The Red Devils were reduced to 10 men in the eighth minute when Leny Yoro got his marching orders, and would go on to concede four times without reply in the game. New manager Mauricio Pochettino started with a back three, with Patrick Dorgu and Diogo Dalot operating as wing-backs. Dalot has been particularly disappointing this season, and United are likely to seek an upgrade in 2027. Ideally, the Red Devils would like someone with defensive discipline and attacking pedigree, who can quickly adapt to Pochettino’s tactics. That has seen them heavily linked with a move for United States Men’s National Team (USMNT) right-back Alex Freeman. USMNT’s rising star Freeman rose through the ranks at Orlando City, before moving to Villarreal this summer. Since the move, the 22-year-old has become indispensable for the Yellow Submarine, featuring in all but one game this season. The American has also been equally decisive for his nation, most recently under Pochettino. The Argentine left his position as USMNT manager last week to take charge at Old Trafford. The Red Devils have subsequently been linked with several of Pochettino’s former players, including Freeman. An update on their pursuit of the player has now emerged that will certainly be of interest to fans. Alex Freeman vs Diogo Dalot: 2026/27 Stats Page 1 of 4 1 2 3 4 United planning January move for Freeman According to Football Insider , United are planning a move for Alex Freeman in the January transfer window. The report states: “Manchester United are plotting a move to sign Villarreal star Alex Freeman in January, sources have told Football Insider.” The report insists that the USMNT speedster has been on the Red Devils’ wish list for a while and that he has impressed scouts with his performances. Speaking on the Transfer Insider podcast, journalist Pete O’Rourke added: “There will be players in that US national team that Pochettino will be a big fan of. If he feels any player from that squad that can come in and improve the Manchester United side, then that is something he’d be foolish not to look at as well.” “There’s been talk of Alex Freeman the fullback from Villarreal as being a potential target, after he has been outstanding playing in Spain. Obviously defence is going to be a top priority for United over the next couple of transfer windows to try and reshape the squad, and Pochettino could be key to that deal.” The report reiterates that Freeman is open to a move to the Theatre of Dreams. Why? ✅ United need an upgrade at right-back. ✅ Alex Freeman has been heavily linked with United since Pochettino’s arrival. ⚠️ INEOS could target someone with Premier League experience for the job. item.title: “The Game Has Passed Him,” “Time To Fire Him”: Chargers Fans Call for Jim Harbaugh’s Exit After Embarrassing Loss to Jets
item.description: Jim Harbaugh © Imagn. Jim Harbaugh has reached an unwanted milestone, and fans are calling for his dismissal. On Sunday, the veteran head coach witnessed his Los Angeles Chargers lose 27-24 at home to the New York Jets. With the Chargers now 1-9, Harbaugh will have his first losing record in the NFL, an 8-8 showing with the San Francisco 49ers in 2014 being his previous career-worst in the league. During his post-game press conference, he could not hide his disappointment at the result : “Everything we’re doing is for the future, and for next Sunday. It tears us up to not win for them. That’s all we know how to do is to go back to work, keep working at it, and do anything and everything we can to give them a win. More work to be done, and we’re going to work at it.” However, there was plenty of criticism toward Harbaugh online: Justin Herbert had a torrid outing despite scoring three total touchdowns (two passing, both to Ladd McConkey, and one rushing), as he generated just 131 passing yards and was sacked six times. For the Jets, Geno Smith notched 176 yards and three touchdowns, two of them to Sterling Shepard. Kicker Jason Sanders made a pair of field goals. Jim Harbaugh could resign from Chargers after disastrous 2026 season – execs Throughout 2026, speculation has abounded on whether Jim Harbaugh will be fired. It persisted even as the Chargers refused to trade away key assets like Khalil Mack and Daiyan Henley before the deadline, but an anonymous executive told Casino.org’s Jason La Canfora in a feature published after Sunday’s game that a quick resignation after the season was likelier: “I could see him walking away, I really could. I’ve known him a long time, and he doesn’t look quite right to me. This is the first time I’ve watched him coach and thought he looks old. Something is not right there.” Meanwhile, another said: “One thing about Jim, he knows when to pull the chute.” The Chargers next play the New England Patriots on Nov. 29. Kickoff is at 1:05 p.m. PT on CBS. item.title: Atletico's Simeone breaks La Liga victories record
item.description: Diego Simeone beat the record of Luis Aragones, who recorded his final La Liga victory in 2004 [Getty Images] Atletico Madrid's 3-0 victory over Getafe may have been routine, but the win was another landmark in manager Diego Simeone's lengthy tenure at the club. Sunday's triumph at Estadio Coliseum was the Argentine's 345th La Liga win in his 567th match, surpassing the record for the most victories in the Spanish top flight. Simeone beat the mark of legendary former Atletico and Spain manager Luis Aragones, who won 344 matches but needed 189 more games to reach that total. "It makes me happy," Simeone said of setting the new mark, with his side now third in the table after 10 wins from 13 games. "I don't usually find many things to be happy about, but there is an incredible amount of work behind this." Questioned about the perception that his team are defensive, Simeone said that was a "constant criticism we face". He added: "I don't place much value on it, but I do take note of it. "This narrative that we're a defensive team, as if we're always playing solely to defend. You don't win 345 matches just by defending. Is that even possible?" The 56-year-old has been in charge of Atletico since December 2011, joining the club in an era when Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid and Pep Guardiola's Barcelona were the dominant teams in Spain. He outlasted the pair of managerial superstars, leading Atletico into a period of consistent success and staying with his side long enough to witness Mourinho's return to Real this summer, 13 years after his initial departure. Having won the Europa League in May 2012, after his appointment on 23 December 2011, Simeone led Atletico to the European Super Cup title three months later. He then won the Copa del Rey in his first full season and secured the club's first La Liga title since 1996 - when Simeone was an Atletico player - in the following campaign. Atletico have established themselves as the third force in Spanish football under his leadership, qualifying for the Champions League in every full season under his charge. However he has been unable to win European football's premier competition, losing in the final to city rivals Real twice in heart-breaking fashion - in extra-time in 2014 after Real scored a stoppage-time equaliser, and on penalties in 2016. Simeone's last silverware arrived in 2021 when he won a second Spanish league championship, while he also guided the team to a Europa League and Super Cup double in 2018. His contract expires at the end of this season with the Atletico fanbase now waiting to see if their manager intends to extend his remarkable victory record into another campaign. item.description: Tension has gripped Daura in Katsina State following the emergence of a viral video in which a foreign female tourist accused the Emir of Daura, Alhaji Dr. Faruk Umar Faruk, of inappropriate sexual conduct during a visit to his palace. The allegations, which have generated widespread reactions on social media, are currently under review by the Daura Emirate Council, which says it is investigating the authenticity of the video and the claims made by the tourist. The woman, identified as Mirka and known on Instagram by the handle @beduinqa, posted the video after completing a 30-day tour of different parts of Nigeria. In a statement accompanying the footage, she alleged that the incident occurred on Saturday, November 14, 2026, when she visited the Emir’s palace in Daura. According to her account, she was ushered into a large room where she met privately with the Emir. She alleged that during their conversation, the Emir held her hand and began playing with it despite her objections. Mirka claimed she repeatedly asked him to stop, writing: “I told him, ‘Your Highness, no, no, no. You should not be touching me like that.’ But he just laughed.” She further alleged that as the meeting ended, the Emir hugged her, kissed her on the cheeks and touched her breast without her consent. The tourist said the encounter left her shocked, disgusted and emotionally distressed, adding that it was the only alleged incident of sexual harassment she experienced throughout her month-long tour of Nigeria. She also claimed she was able to capture the encounter using a pair of Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses equipped with a built-in camera, and alleged that she may not have been the first woman to experience such conduct but might have been the first to record it. Reacting to the development, the spokesman of the Daura Emirate Council, Ibrahim Usman Murtala, confirmed in a telephone interview with our correspondent on Monday that the Emirate was aware of the viral video. Emir of Daura, Alhaji Dr. Faruk Umar Faruk He said the Emirate had commenced a review of the footage to determine its authenticity and ascertain whether it had been altered or manipulated using any form of technology. According to him, the Emirate will issue an official statement after concluding its internal review of the matter. As of the time of filing this report, neither the Emir of Daura nor the Daura Emirate Council had issued a substantive response to the specific allegations made by the tourist. Foreign tourist, Mirka, during her visit to the Emir’s palace in Daura. Our warriors deployed seven Ukrainian-made naval drones. Despite all the enemy’s efforts to counter the attack, the Russian corvette Merkury was sunk,” Zelensky wrote on X. This handout satellite photo taken and released by the Satellite image ©2026 Vantor shows the view of a Russian ship docked at the Benghazi port before a strike, on November 21, 2026. Result: target hit,” he added. A Ka-27 combat helicopter was also destroyed in the strike on the Merkury, Zelensky said. Sunday’s strikes came after a drone hit a Russian cargo ship in the eastern Baltic Sea on Saturday, close to the waters of Finland, whose border guard said the strike was Ukrainian. The UN mission in Libya expressed “serious concern” over the attacks, calling for “an immediate, independent and transparent investigation”. “Libya cannot afford, and must not become a battleground for foreign conflicts,” the UNSMIL wrote on X. item.title: Old-school Linux desktops find fresh routes to Wayland
item.description: Xfce's next release is taking shape for 2027, while MATE users have fresh options for moving their familiar desktop onto Wayland. One of the oldest surviving Linux desktops has a relatively slow release schedule: new stable releases of Xfce tend to appear every two years. The project just updated its release engineering roadmap for the forthcoming Xfce 4.22, and it looks like the next version won't arrive until early next year. We covered the release of Xfce 4.20 in December 2024, but 4.22 is still incubating. The roadmap schedules its first prerelease and feature freeze for December 15, 2026, followed by a second prerelease on January 15, 2027. A third prerelease is optional, and neither that nor the final release has a date. February or March might be plausible, but that's our guess, not the project's promise. The Xfce developers tend not to rush into things. Wayland development continues in 4.22, building on the preliminary support in 4.20. The team is also working on its own compositor, xfwl4, although the roadmap doesn't promise feature parity with X11. (In Wayland terminology, the "compositor" is the combined display server and window manager.) The compositor has its own development roadmap . The name is a nod to the current Xfce X11 window manager, which is called xfwm4 . The main developer of the new xfwl4 compositor is Brian Tarricone , who has been working on other parts of Xfce since 2004. Back in July, he shared a blog post about his use of generative-AI coding assistants called LLMs and xfwl4 . He says: "So yes, I use Claude quite a bit while developing xfwl4. I don't vibe-code, ever, and I probably use the LLM to generate less code than most people do. After all, building things with code is my hobby and passion (and I'm lucky I got to do it professionally for a quarter century), and driving an LLM is kinda boring." We find this somewhat reassuring, but any really passionate anti-LLM Xfce users reading this may be glad that the release schedules of Ubuntu LTS versions and Xfce stable releases are so far out of sync – sticking with Xubuntu 26.04 means there's no immediate need to adopt the new LLM-assisted compositor. Or, of course, simply keep using X11 instead of Wayland – although that might eventually mean choosing a distro that maintains X11 support, perhaps through XLibre, which has other drawbacks for some. There are other options, too. We've also seen an independent fork of xfwm4 called xfwm4-gl . It's in active development and uses OpenGL to perform window compositing directly, while the current version uses the now rather old Xrender extension . Labwc and MATE Wayland, and Wayfire, and Polo too Last year, when we looked at the release candidate of openSUSE Leap 16.0 , we found that it ran Xfce on Wayland by replacing Xfwm4 with the labwc compositor that we first saw in PiOS 5.2 .
